item.title: Tesla driver killed in Malibu crash identified as 16-year-old student
item.description: The California Highway Patrol is continuing its investigation into a fatal solo-vehicle crash on Malibu Canyon Road that claimed the life of a 16-year-old student on Wednesday morning. item.title: California high-sped rail track installation set to begin in Kern County

item.title: Rick Caruso officially not running for LA mayor
item.description: Billionaire developer Rick Caruso said Thursday he is not running for LA mayor in the upcoming 2026 election. item.title: UCLA professor mentioned in Epstein files faces backlash
item.description: Mark Tramo, a neurologist who has taught at UCLA for more than a decade in neurology and music-related research, is mentioned multiple times in documents tied to Jeffrey Epstein. item.title: Matthew Stafford named NFL MVP and announces return to Rams
item.description: Matthew Stafford edged Drake Maye for the AP NFL Most Valuable Player award on Thursday night in the closest race since Peyton Manning and Steve McNair were co-winners in 2003.Stafford received 24 of 50 first-place votes while Maye got 23. But Maye has a chance to go home this week with a Vince Lombardi Trophy.
